name: ParcelResolve synthetic recovery evaluation v1
split_policy: Development fixtures live under tests/fixtures and seed.py. Evaluation order identifiers are 71001–71040 and contain independently authored names, addresses, line prices, quantities and requests. Evaluation scenarios are visible executable acceptance fixtures, not a sequestered statistical benchmark.
transformations: Fixture specifications map to the typed OrderSnapshot schema at runtime.
Money is computed by integer multiplication and addition only.
Seeded schedules insert delayed, duplicated and out-of-order observational events; the same schedule is used in each comparison profile.
Crash scenarios expand over all mutating action kinds and three durable boundaries.
prohibited_claims: No merchant adoption or handling-time benefit estimate
No validation of real carrier stop, interception, void guarantees or warehouse holds
comparison_note: Both profiles are offline. The SOP profile uses an operator-selected intent. The deterministic-intake profile calls the shipped rule interpreter. No fixture lookup or evaluation gold is passed to the interpreter. No live AI calls are performed.
